fields.description: - Initial corpus includes federal-style-canon entries for government UI copy editing — covering USWDS forms, GOV.UK error/form patterns and Service Manual writing for user interfaces, VA.gov Content Style Guide (error anatomy, capitalization, punctuation), 18F Plain Language guide, Federal Plain Language Guidelines (Plain Writing Act of 2010), and CDC reading-level guidance. Each entry carries a stable rule ID, a prior-art citation, and a precedence field. Required by depending epic f360-3a5b-b8f3-4f86 (gov-copy-writer sub-agent).
